name: julianosirtori-skills
description: Agent Skills by Juliano Sirtori. Each skill is a plain SKILL.md folder that also works in OpenCode, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and other agents.

plugins.name: mac-cleanup
plugins.description: Analyze and safely free up disk space on macOS: measures what uses storage, cleans only caches that rebuild themselves, finds leftovers of uninstalled apps and guides the removals that need your judgment.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Run a feature, bug fix or refactor through a fast crew: the orchestrator writes the spec, contracts and a task board, fans implementation and tests out to up to 10 parallel Haiku workers (a bundled crew-worker agent), integrates, runs the checks and reviews, with Haiku QA and an independent Reviewer for large or risky changes, sized runs (small work goes solo) and capped fix loops.

plugins.name: product-naming
plugins.description: Find a brandable product or company name and check it can be owned: generates candidates in batches by strategy, bulk-checks domains straight from the registries (self-tested RDAP/whois), filters by meaning and sound in every market language, scores fit and marketing potential, and vets finalists (who owns a taken .com, search conflicts, USPTO/INPI/WIPO pre-screen, social handles).

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: End a session and continue in a fresh one without losing context: writes a self-contained handoff (goal, verified state, next steps, decisions, dead ends, user preferences, files to read, running processes, git snapshot) to .handoffs/, copies a short start prompt to the clipboard, and resumes by checking the handoff against the current code and git state.

plugins.name: pentest
plugins.description: White-box security audit for your own web app or API: read-only scan plus OWASP Top 10 review of code, auth, deps and headers, with a ranked report and fixes.

plugins.name: seo-geo
plugins.description: Improve SEO and visibility in AI chats (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, AI Overviews, Claude, Copilot): crawler-eye audit (robots and CDN blocks per AI bot, JS-only rendering, indexability, JSON-LD), a full-site crawler (broken links, redirects, duplicates, orphans, depth, sitemap gaps), backlink analysis from Search Console/Bing/Ahrefs/Semrush exports with links to reclaim and a competitor link gap, a prompt set measuring citations and wrong claims, Search Console quick wins, code fixes, quotable content and a prioritized report.

plugins.name: docs-sync
plugins.description: Create and update README.md and AGENTS.md so they match the code: a stdlib script inventories the repo and finds drift (dead commands, broken links and paths, stale env vars, oversized or duplicated agent files, what changed since each doc), then the skill makes the smallest accurate edit, keeps one home per fact (README for humans, AGENTS.md for agents, CLAUDE.md importing it), prunes instead of appending, never invents commands and verifies before reporting.
